concept: Setting a long-term goal and reasoning backward to the steps required now
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic multi-year goal (career, financial, personal) with an adult who hasn't yet mapped concrete near-term steps
exercise.reflection_prompt: Working backward from the goal, what has to be true a year from now, and what has to happen this month?
exercise.practice: Adult reasons backward from a real goal of their own to identify one concrete near-term step

assessment.success_marker: adult identifies a specific, actionable near-term step tied logically to the long-term goal
